summary.intent: Continue building out monokl: land the invariants reconciliation (PR #55 code, PR #54 docs), then start the goal work by building an rg ground-truth harness after the user approved two defaults (lossy non-UTF-8 reads with a count, honoring parent ignore files inside the git repo root).
summary.outcome: PR #55 was reported as ready, with byte-identical CLI evidence, 602 tests, 97.25% coverage and the expected 7 semver lints; macOS Test and Entire Gates were still pending. The rg harness was then written on a new branch off main with a just recipe and CONTRIBUTING docs, run once against pinned repos, and committed. Misses were diagnosed (e.g. test files missed) but not yet fixed.

repo: Callisto release dry-run (`just changesets` step 2) can fail with E320 locally when the clone lacks the release tag or post-release commits differ; CI Changesets job passes, so cause was not confirmed. `git fetch --tags` is needed before judging.
cargo semver-checks does not flag removed Serialize/Deserialize impls, so changesets and PR bodies must list them by hand.
Public trait signature changes (ToDomainError::to_domain_error losing ErrorContext) show up as trait_method_parameter_count_changed in semver-checks.
TokenizerInit error variant was not unconstructed; a pipeline test used it as a stand-in error, so audit claims of 'dead' need a grep of tests too.
AGENTS.md says specs are plans unless code implements them; ADRs are history and are not edited.
The rg harness uses public pinned TS repos (zustand, zod, axios) resolved by release tag SHA, and is run on demand via a justfile recipe documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.

code.finding: Added a recipe that runs the rg ground-truth comparison harness against pinned repos on demand.
Documents the rg ground-truth harness and how to run it.

workflow: The worktree guard refuses plain git, `-C`, and compound commands; use /usr/bin/git. Creating a branch needed several attempts, ending with pointing HEAD at the new branch.
Commits need the sandbox disabled for GPG signing, and cargo needs it disabled for the registry cache.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority; verify claims (CI status, E320) independently before relaying.
Run a new harness once and categorize misses (test vs non-test files) before fixing anything.

friction: Worktree guard quirks (plain git refused, transient push '(failed)' needing retry, refused zsh globs and heredocs) slow down routine git work.
macOS CI runners are slow or queued, delaying #55's final green.
Branch creation from main in the worktree did not take on the first try and required checking state and repointing HEAD.
Resolving latest release tag SHAs required many repeated gh calls.
open_items: Confirm #55 CI finishes green (macOS Test, Entire Gates) and that the user merges #54 and #55.
Determine whether E320 in `just changesets` reproduces on main with tags fetched.
Fix harness-found misses (e.g. Action missing test files) and use the harness as the conservation test.
Implement hit-first retrieval with snippets and member-level blocks, and single-read parallel speed.
Implement lossy non-UTF-8 reads with a count diagnostic and parent ignore-file handling inside the git repo root.
Hold the library-only minor release and batch it with the next user-visible work.
Optional guards: soft-failure ratchet, semver gate keyed to pending bump, release rehearsal, 'planned' labels for unbuilt docs.
Housekeeping: close or update trails 183/185/190/191/200, remove stale agent worktrees, decide Entire Gates for bot PRs, branch protection and TAP_APP repo list.
Left alone in #55: FileAnalysis::language()/is_typescript(), one-variant DependencyTarget, stale ADR 0001 text, and spec docs 01/02/03/07/08 describing removed items.
